title: Joel And Kerri — Mbira Folk (Zimbabwe)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone alto love duet 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona Zimbabwe Australia
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
He came from Australia, she came from the red earth
They met somewhere between the ending and the birth
Of something neither had a word for yet
A feeling like the mbira plays — vibrating and direct

[Verse 2]
She had the farm in her, he had the ocean
Two different kinds of knowing, two different kinds of motion
He learned her language in the space between their hands
The way the hosho shakes — she helped him understand

[Chorus]
Joel and Kerri, two countries in one song
Zimbabwe in the morning, Australia all along
The mbira plays the distance, the guitar holds the ground
Joel and Kerri found what they were looking for — they found

[Bridge]
Her father Jeff had watched enough sunrises
To know a steady man when one arrived
Her mother Jill had run enough dawns
To see that Joel would not be the kind who survived by luck
But by the same intention that runs a dairy farm

[Verse 3]
They made a daughter who can sing the morning
Ari carries both the farm and the sea in her voice
The red dust and the salt air
The mbira and the guitar
Joel and Kerri — that was always the choice

[Outro]
Joel and Kerri
Joel and Kerri
Two countries, one heart
The mbira plays on
